ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_regret_weighted_diff_exp_normalized
ir.intuition: This loss shifts the paradigm from ranking and logistic preference to a regret-based exponential decay loss that emphasizes the relative regret difference between pairs. It normalizes the log-probability differences and weighs the loss by a nonlinear transform of delta_regret, encouraging the model to focus learning on pairs with significant regret differences, thus capturing nuanced performance gaps.
ir.pseudocode: regret_gap = delta_regret; diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l; norm_diff = diff / (abs(diff) + epsilon); weight_factor = sigmoid(regret_gap); loss_per_pair = weight * exp(- norm_diff * weight_factor); return mean(loss_per_pair)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    epsilon = 1e-6
    log_prob_w = batch["log_prob_w"]
    log_prob_l = batch["log_prob_l"]
    weight = batch["weight"]
    delta_regret = batch.get("delta_regret", ops.zeros_like(log_prob_w))
    diff = ops.sub(log_prob_w, log_prob_l)
    norm_diff = ops.div(diff, ops.add(ops.abs(diff), epsilon))
    weight_factor = ops.sigmoid(delta_regret)
    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(weight, ops.exp(ops.neg(ops.mul(norm_diff, weight_factor))))
    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)
